\section{Surprisal at the critical region}

Table~\ref{tab:calibration} reports mean surprisal at the critical region for
NP/Z items in the ambiguous and control conditions. The garden-path effect is
the difference between them, and it is comparable across the two open models.

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{lccc}
\toprule
Model & Ambiguous & Control & $\Delta$ \\
\midrule
GPT-2-large   & $16.88 \pm 3.07$ & $10.77 \pm 2.94$ & 6.11 \\
Pythia-1.4B   & $16.74 \pm 3.28$ & $11.21 \pm 3.13$ & 5.54 \\
GPT-3 davinci & $15.02 \pm 2.81$ & $9.88 \pm 2.67$  & 5.14 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{Mean surprisal in bits at the critical region for NP/Z items,
mean $\pm$ standard deviation over 72 items per cell.}
\label{tab:calibration}
\end{table}
